_comment: How a race is set up. Edit this and restart the sim - nothing else needs
Every value here can be overridden by an environment variable, and the
variable wins. That is so a deployment can differ from the file without
editing it (deploy/docker-compose.yml sets a few), but if you are just
running the thing, this file is the place to change it.
Who the bots can BE - which races, which factions, which classes each race
may take, and the syllables their names are built from - lives next door in
//bots: How many race at once. SIM_BOTS overrides.
//classes: Which classes are in the field. "*" means every class the edition has,
which is also the only way both factions appear - no single class is open
Or name them: ["Warrior", "Shaman", "Mage"]. SIM_CLASS overrides, as a
//hardcore: Death is permanent. Not the same race with a harsher penalty - it uses its
own death rate, because people play it differently. About a quarter of the
//speed: Sim minutes per real second. At 1 a race lasts about ten hours, which is
meant to be ambient - something to come back to. At 30 one resolves in
about twenty minutes, which is better for watching or for a demo.
//intermission: Seconds between one race finishing and the next starting. SIM_INTERMISSION overrides.
//edition: Which talent data to race on. SIM_EDITION overrides.
